name: LBS-27B

lineage.how_derived: about 10K cold-start SFT examples, then 80 GRPO steps (batch 64, 8 rollouts per prompt) on synthetic GUI grounding data only

purpose: Learn an observation policy from GUI grounding (select and inspect image regions, zoom in, revisit the original) and transfer it to general visual question answering and high-resolution perception without any general-domain VQA training (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card tag apache-2.0; no LICENSE file in the repo, text not read; base Qwen3.8-27B is Apache-2.0 (see its record).

architecture.why_this_design: Unchanged base architecture; agentic zoom-in tool: up to two independent crops per turn, a budget of three crop calls per episode.

pc-12gb.notes: 18.1 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-16gb.notes: 18.1 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-24gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (21.6 GB)

pc-32gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (29.6 GB)

mac-16-24gb.notes: 18.1 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 18.1 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 18.1 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: the zoom-in tool loop is the vendor's harness (UI-Venus repo, branch LBS); plain llama.cpp gives only the base VLM

tona_fit.reason: GUI-grounding specialist on the Qwen3.8-27B base: relevant only for a computer-use role, and it adds nothing for repository coding.
